data: In fiscal 2024 (the year ended September 28, 2024), Apple reported net sales of $391,035 million, gross profit (reported as "gross margin") of $180,683 million, and operating income of $123,216 million. That works out to a gross margin of about 46.2% ($180,683M divided by $391,035M) and an operating margin of about 31.5% ($123,216M divided by $391,035M). Both improved from fiscal 2023, when gross profit was $169,148 million on net sales of $383,285 million (about 44.1%) and operating income was $114,301 million (about 29.8%).
